fusions.name: Lick the Plate
fusions.desc: Sends the swarm to finish an enemy at or below 30% health for 24 damage, and heals you for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Uninvited Guests
fusions.desc: The swarm lands on every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Stripped to Bone
fusions.desc: The swarm strips every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Full-Bellied Fury
fusions.desc: Whenever you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
